name: Pazlume
subtitle: Find value. Make the deal.
promotionalText: Read the clues, negotiate a price and turn second-hand finds into your next deal. Every purchase is a decision.
description:
Build a trading career one second-hand find at a time.

Browse 80 fictional products across electronics, cameras, retro goods, home appliances, furniture and everyday items. Read seller claims, ask about faults and negotiate before spending your game cash.

Inspect your purchases, develop category knowledge and decide whether a repair is worth its cost. Set your asking price, consider buyer offers and see the complete profit or loss after each sale. Estimates guide your judgment without guaranteeing a buyer or a profit.

Earn access to more demanding products and source items for recurring clients. After three career trades, Weekly Flip offers a separate bankroll and a fresh shared weekly market seed. Weekly results and achievements are stored on your device.

Six recurring buyers offer eighteen connected requests. Filter the market for suitable models, verify the actual condition, and compare a client payment with an ordinary sale. Complete their stories to earn cosmetic profile titles.

Play offline in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish or Italian. No ads, in-app purchases or player-account registration. All money, products, buyers and sellers are fictional. Your career saves locally on your device; deleting the app removes its local saves.

Plan repairs before paying: choose which known faults to fix, compare the total cost with the estimated value recovered, and apply the selected work together. You can also leave the item as-is.

Preview the possible net result and the effect on open buyer offers before revising an asking price. Saving the same price preserves the negotiation.

Review your trade notebook by category: compare realized proceeds, total costs and profit or loss from completed sales and client deliveries, then reopen recent receipts. Past gains do not guarantee the next sale.

When pricing a repeat model, reopen your last normal market receipt. Quiet listings can offer a price review using your estimate and past sales; the game never changes your asking price for you.

Active client requests occasionally guide ordinary arrivals toward an accessible requested model. You still need to judge its price, condition and repairs.
